create.name: Jocelyn Star Feather
create.bio:
Jocelyn Star Feather, who also publishes as Jocelyn Mercado, is an American spiritual guide and astrologer who runs her work under the name Sacred Planet from Asheville, North Carolina. She spent around fifteen years in corporate finance after an MBA, with employers including Cadbury and Mercedes-Benz, before a strong spiritual opening around the birth of her first daughter in 2010 turned her towards shamanic and earth-based practice, which she studied with elders and wisdom keepers.

Her teaching draws together shamanic journeying, alchemy, astrology and the mythology of the ancient world, especially the goddesses and temples of Egypt. She teaches mainly online, through recorded courses on myth, synchronicity and the sacred feminine that are often offered on a donation basis, and through regular astrology talks and guided journeys on her YouTube channel. Each year she also leads small-group pilgrimages to Egyptian temple sites and retreats in Central America, where ceremony, sound and shamanic journeys are part of the programme. Alongside the spiritual work she coaches teachers and healers on building online summits and becoming more visible with their message.

courses.title: Mysteries of the Great Goddess: Egypt Pilgrimage
courses.description: A two-week ceremonial journey through the temples and pyramids of Egypt, with visits to sites linked to Isis, Hathor, Sekhmet, Seshet and Ma'at. Shamanic journeys and sound work take place along the way, with guest speakers.
courses.price: Early bird $9,500 USD (registrations by 6 Nov 2026); $1,500 USD deposit

courses.title: Reclaiming Lilith Retreat: A Return to the Garden of Eden
courses.description: An eight-day retreat in Costa Rica, co-led with Eimear Stassin, exploring the figure of Lilith and the sacred feminine through ritual and time in nature.
courses.price: $5,500 USD per person (double occupancy) from 1 Oct 2026; single supplement $1,200 USD

courses.title: Mysteries of Egypt: The Keys to Our Future Are Hidden In the Past
courses.description: A recorded online course on the spiritual teachings of ancient Egypt and what they offer people today, with guided shamanic journeys.
courses.price: By donation until 15 Nov 2026; regular price $777 USD

courses.title: Miracles, Synchronicity, and Power
courses.description: A recorded course on noticing meaningful coincidence and working consciously with your own creative power. It mixes teaching, myth and practices.
courses.price: By donation until 15 Nov 2026; regular price $777 USD

courses.title: Alchemy of the Wild Soul
courses.description: A three-month recorded journey that uses the constellations, star lore and animal teachers to work on personal and collective renewal.
courses.price: By donation until 15 Nov 2026; regular price $499 USD

courses.title: The Great Goddesses of Earth & Sky
courses.description: A twelve-week embodiment course meeting goddesses from several ancient traditions, from the underworld to the sky, through story, ritual and journeying.
courses.price: By donation until 15 Nov 2026; regular price $777 USD

courses.title: Into the Mythica
courses.description: A course on writing your own forward-looking personal mythology and taking a long-postponed step towards your purpose.
courses.price: By donation until 15 Nov 2026; regular price $888 USD

free_resources.title: The Goddess in Her Act of Creation
free_resources.description: A free video talk and guided shamanic journey, sent on sign-up, that grew from a dream she had about a creating goddess. It looks at reconnecting with your own creative power.

free_resources.title: Venturing into the Great Cosmic Ocean
free_resources.description: A free recorded workshop on the old ways of seeing the night sky and the star knowledge carried by ancient cultures.

free_resources.title: Light Filled Shamanic Journey to Harmonize Your Heart with the Great Above & Great Below
free_resources.description: A free guided shamanic journey of about fifteen minutes on her YouTube channel, linking the heart with sky and earth.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link (home, about, online courses, interviews, mystery-school pages and sitemap checked, 4 Nov 2026). Her 'Into the Mythica' course resembles her Shift course on the saved list but does not name Shift.
Email is her brand inbox (hello@weAreSacredPlanet.com), published on her retreat pages.
Also known as Jocelyn Mercado (older site images and course pages use that name).
Regional: Asheville, North Carolina (about page: 'She lives in Asheville, North Carolina').

YouTube and socials are under her brand Sacred Planet; the channel is mainly hers but also hosts guest interviews. Videos picked are hers by description (Kk2IDc321i8 is an interview with her; L_DWtRWL510, bgIIEANvswo and sybOf0BD9BU describe her teaching but do not name the speaker in the title).
Video titles have their leading emojis removed.

Her blog has 'Atlantis, Egypt & Göbekli Tepe' and 'A brief history of the last 200,000 years' alternative-history posts and channelled transmissions; no anti-vaccine or similar conspiracy content seen.
Costa Rica retreat price: the $4,900 special ended 30 Sep 2026, so the $5,500 price from 1 Oct is given (regular price shown as $6,900); Egypt early bird ends 6 Nov 2026.
